Class PatientTrackerController

java.lang.Object
com.hospital.admissions.controller.PatientTrackerController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/v1/patients") public class PatientTrackerController extends Object
REST controller for Patient and Family Journey Tracking operations.

Exposes endpoints for real-time queue milestone lookups, patient reassurance actions, patient identity tokens, ward check-in, bedside vacating, and terminal cleaning triggers.
